goal: Speed up wallet rescans during imports, restores, and node startup
Evaluate compact block filters in parallel across CPU cores to cut scan times from minutes to seconds
agreement: Broad support for the speedup, but blocked by an open correctness objection
Unaddressed objection: edge cases in parallel filter checks could cause skipped payments (polespinasa)
Verified 4.5x to 6x rescan speedup through independent benchmarks (ismaelsadeeq)
Verified 3x rescan speedup on HDD hardware (l0rinc)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it significantly cuts wallet rescan times on multi-core machines
Benchmarks show 3x to 6x speedups, cutting runtimes from several minutes to under 30 seconds
Directly benefits users importing keys, restoring backups, or scanning large block ranges
